design.arrival: Snapshot month end; first eligible service is the following month.
design.priority: Frozen score descending, then cve_id ascending, using evaluate.ranked_indices.
design.completion: End of service month; sensitivity completes the same selections at month start.
design.before: Completion date strictly earlier than KEV date; after includes the same date.
design.capacity: Equal effort; unused monthly slots expire; no pre-2025 backlog. Listed rows remain in the backlog.
design.chart: Cumulative eventual before-listing successes by completion month; confirmation curve counts the 55 pool KEV dates.
design.budget_42: 42 per month is about the yearly 500 benchmark budget (504 slots). January has no eligible rows, so at most 462 are used.

uncertainty.method: Paired month-block bootstrap; sample 12 snapshot cohorts with replacement, retaining original calendar dates. Repeated cohorts consume repeated capacity. Rerun backlog; compare with the best baseline in each draw.
uncertainty.limitation: Only 55 positives and 12 month blocks: noisy. Conditional on fitted scores; excludes model-selection uncertainty and does not simulate future years.

limits: KEV date proxies confirmation and can lag real attacks.
Equal effort per fix; no asset inventory, patch availability or partial repairs.
2025 development data; no untouched validation. Current CVSS is a retrospective reference.
110 publication-month listings are outside this pool. Later KEV absence is unobserved, not safe.
